P. (जलति) 
__1 To be rich or wealthy. 
__2 To cover, hide, screen. 
__3 To cover (as with a net), encircle, entangle. 
__4 To be sharp. 
__5 To be cold, stiff, dull, or dumb. --

a. [जल् अच् डस्य लो वा]

.]]
